Petitioner(s) Through :- Mr. Arshad Hussain, Advocate v/s Union of India Through Secretary to Government Ministry of Defence, Government of India, New Delhi .....Respondent(s) Through :- Mr. Sumant Sudan, Advocate vice Mr. Vishal Sharma, Dsgi Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Kumar, Judge Order
texts.facts: This is a petition seeking quashing of communication dated 23 rd May, 2014 addressed to the petitioner by the respondents in response to an application made under Right to Information Act. There are other allied reliefs prayed for in this petition. The respondents have filed their objections and have opposed the maintainability of the petition on merits. It is submitted that the case of the petitioner for his appointment as Sanitary Inspector-cum-Food Inspector was resubmitted to Ministry of Defence by DG DE in compliance with the interim order dated 17th July, 2014, but the Ministry has rejected the same on the ground that the notification relied upon has ceased to exist consequent upon repeal of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 in the year 2006. Date Of Pronouncement: 20.12.2025 vs Union Of India Through Secretary To on 20 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173024822/ 1 2025:JKLHC-JMU:4375 Accordingly, this petition is dismissed along with connected applications. In the instant petition, the petitioner has thrown challenge to an order dated 16th September, 2014, whereby proposal of the Director General Defence Estates for notification of the petitioner as Sanitary Inspector, has been rejected.
